title: Eosinophil–neutrophil interaction does not improve frozen prediction of pre-bronchodilator airflow obstruction across NHANES cycles
abstract: For adults40–79 with high-quality complete measurements, adding a log eosinophil×log neutrophil term to a flexible additive risk/count model did not establish improved detection of pre-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC<0.70 in independently sampled NHANES2011–12 after fitting in2007–08: target weighted AUC 0.785210 to 0.785142, delta -0.000068, conditional95% interval [-0.000288,0.000154]. Source n2252/449 events; target n2118/373. Source-refit uncertainty and sensitivity analyses do not justify primary superiority. Same-survey protocols, selection and pre-bronchodilator fixed threshold limit the claim; not a COPD diagnostic study. Reproducible code, provenance and author checks provided.

citations.reason: Primary additive inflammatory-marker/lung-function associations motivate the specified incremental nonadditivity test; source data partly overlap.
